comment:
* Class that reads and stores the carrier privileged rules from the UICC.
 *
 * The rules are read when the class is created, hence it should only be created
 * after the UICC can be read. And it should be deleted when a UICC is changed.
 *
 * Document: https://source.android.com/devices/tech/config/uicc.html
 *
 * {@hide}

variables.name: MAX_RETRY
variables.comment: Max number of retries for open logical channel, interval is 5s.

variables.name: mStatusMessage
variables.comment: LocalLog buffer to hold important status messages for debugging.

variables.name: mChannelId
variables.comment: Channel Id for communicating with UICC.

variables.name: mRetryCount
variables.comment: Number of retries for open logical channel.

variables.name: mCheckedRules
variables.comment: Flag that used to mark whether get rules from ARA-D.

variables.name: mAIDInUse
variables.comment: Message component to identify which AID is currently in-use.

methods.name: public boolean areCarrierPriviligeRulesLoaded()
methods.comment: * Returns true if the carrier privilege rules have finished loading.

methods.name: public boolean hasCarrierPrivilegeRules()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the carrier privilege rules have finished loading and some rules were
     * specified.

methods.name: public List<String> getPackageNames()
methods.comment:
* Returns package names for privilege rules.
     * Return empty list if no rules defined or package name is empty string.

methods.name: public int getCarrierPrivilegeStatus(Signature signature, String packageName)
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the carrier privileges for the input certificate and package name.
     *
     * @param signature The signature of the certificate.
     * @param packageName name of the package.
     * @return Access status.

methods.name: public int getCarrierPrivilegeStatus(PackageManager packageManager, String packageName)
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the carrier privileges for the input package name.
     *
     * @param packageManager PackageManager for getting signatures.
     * @param packageName name of the package.
     * @return Access status.

methods.name: public int getCarrierPrivilegeStatus(PackageInfo packageInfo)
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the carrier privileges for the input package info.
     *
     * @param packageInfo PackageInfo for the package, containing the package signatures.
     * @return Access status.

methods.name: public int getCarrierPrivilegeStatusForCurrentTransaction(PackageManager packageManager)
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the carrier privileges for the caller of the current transaction.
     *
     * @param packageManager PackageManager for getting signatures and package names.
     * @return Access status.

methods.name: public int getCarrierPrivilegeStatusForUid(PackageManager packageManager, int uid)
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the carrier privileges for the caller of the current transaction.
     *
     * @param packageManager PackageManager for getting signatures and package names.
     * @return Access status.

methods.name: public static boolean shouldRetry(AsyncResult ar, int retryCount)
methods.comment:
* The following three situations could be due to logical channels temporarily unavailable, so
     * we retry up to MAX_RETRY times, with an interval of RETRY_INTERVAL_MS: 1. MISSING_RESOURCE,
     * 2. NO_SUCH_ELEMENT and the status code is 6985, 3. INTERNAL_ERR and the status code is 6999.

methods.name: private boolean isDataComplete()
methods.comment:
* Check if all rule bytes have been read from UICC.
     * For long payload, we need to fetch it repeatly before start parsing it.

methods.name: private static List<UiccAccessRule> parseRules(String rules)
methods.comment: * Parses the rules from the input string.

methods.name: private void updateState(int newState, String statusMessage)
methods.comment: * Updates the state and notifies the UiccCard that the rules have finished loading.

methods.name: public void dump(FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter printWriter, String[] args)
methods.comment: * Dumps info to Dumpsys - useful for debugging.

methods.name: private String getStateString(int state)
methods.comment: * Converts state into human readable format.
